findings.title: Migration 0917 is neutered but still registered and marked as post-deployment
findings.body: The body of convert_org_saved_searches_to_views was replaced with a bare return, so the data migration never copies organization saved searches into GroupSearchView. The migration is still in the chain (and 0920 is also neutered), so environments that already applied the old code will not re-run it, and fresh/other environments silently skip the conversion. The comment points to a file '0921_convert_org_saved_searches_to_views_rerevised.py' that is not part of this diff, so the intended correct migration may not exist.

findings.title: Revised saved-search conversion migration became a no-op, losing data conversion
findings.body: The revised migration 0920 was reduced to an early return, deleting the logic that converts ORGANIZATION-visibility SavedSearch rows into GroupSearchView rows. Its comment references a 0921 migration that does not exist in this change set. As merged, org saved searches are never converted and users lose their org-level views.

findings.title: Analytics event recorded before feature-flag check
findings.body: analytics.record is called for every request, including those rejected with 404 'Feature not enabled' and unauthenticated-feature requests, so usage analytics count traffic from orgs without the feature. It also runs before body validation. Move it after the feature check, or after successful assembly.

findings.title: Parameterizer.parametrize_w_experiments drops ParameterizationRegex support but ParameterizationRegex remains in use
findings.body: The change removes ParameterizationRegexExperiment and the isinstance dispatch in parametrize_w_experiments, so any experiment that is a ParameterizationRegex will now fail (its run method no longer exists). The ParameterizationExperiment type alias now only accepts callable experiments, which is a breaking API change for any caller passing regex experiments and removes the regex experiment tests without replacement.

findings.title: Removal of grouping.experiments.parameterization.traceparent option
findings.body: The option registration is deleted while the parameterization code and grouping config may still read it. Any code calling options.get on this key will now raise an unknown-option error. Confirm no remaining reader exists.

findings.title: Default autofix automation tuning changed from 'low' to 'off' for all projects
findings.body: The default is silently changed, which alters behavior for every existing project that never set the option (it stops autofix automation). This is also reflected in constants.py and tests, but it is a product-behavior change unrelated to the title/description, and it is not called out.

findings.title: Error IDs fetched from replay query without guarding against missing fields and runs before pagination
findings.body: error_ids is read via response[0].get('error_ids', []) from process_raw_response, and fetch_error_details is called eagerly on every request (including every paginated page), issuing Snuba and nodestore queries on each page. Also fetch_error_details zips error_ids with get_multi values, which is only correct if nodestore returns results in the same order and with the same length; missing nodes are silently dropped and misalign the zip.

findings.title: Error events fetched from nodestore with a mismatched zip and no key-to-id mapping
findings.body: In fetch_error_details, `zip(error_ids, events.values())` pairs IDs with dict values by iteration order of the returned mapping, not by key. If get_multi omits any missing node, every subsequent error is attached to the wrong event ID. Iterate over node_ids and look up each key instead.

findings.title: Null max_segment_id skip hides a real data-inconsistency case
findings.body: Returning an empty filename list when max_segment_id is None means recording blobs for that replay are never deleted, while the replay row is still archived by delete_replays. Storage for such replays leaks. The comment also contains the typo 'segements'.

findings.title: Detector update uses 'detector_type' key that is never validated
findings.body: update() reads validated_data.get('detector_type', instance.group_type) and then calls .slug on it; 'detector_type' is not a serializer field (the field is 'type', which is validated to a GroupType class). The result is that the type is never changed on update and instance.group_type may not exist on Detector, risking AttributeError when the key is absent.

findings.title: Logging 'event_data' key now uses workflow_event_data but the outer scope variable may differ
findings.body: The extra payload changed from event_data to workflow_event_data, which changes the log schema for existing log consumers and dashboards keyed on 'event_data' with the shared event payload. Mixed semantics across logs should be checked.

findings.title: Serializer rejects validated age/timestamp combos incorrectly and returns 422 for legitimate reports
findings.body: validate_timestamp and validate_age use truthiness of self.initial_data.get('age'), so age=0 is treated as absent. Also, the endpoint now returns 422 for any malformed report and stops processing the whole batch, where previously it accepted reports. This is a behavior change that can cause browsers to drop valid batches containing one bad report.

findings.title: Browser report body logged with request_body removed, plus dead metric tag type change
findings.body: The logger.info for 'browser_report_received' was removed by the test diff's removal of the logging assertion, reducing observability of the raw payloads that the endpoint is meant to collect for real-world data gathering.

findings.title: noise_config added to DB query injection group type without validation of intent
findings.body: NoiseConfig(ignore_limit=5) is added to DBQueryInjectionVulnerabilityGroupType, changing alerting/noise behavior for this issue type across all projects without a flag gate or accompanying test.

findings.title: Summary query fires with enabled flag only checked on feature list, and tooFewFeedbacks logic is inverted-looking
findings.body: tooFewFeedbacks is computed as numFeedbacksUsed === 0 && !success, which hides the summary only in the case of no feedbacks and failure; other too-few cases (e.g. success false with some feedbacks) show a summary component with null text. The name and condition do not match the described behavior.

findings.title: Table widget under feature flag renders empty hardcoded data instead of query results
findings.body: When organization has 'use-table-widget-visualization', TableWidgetVisualization is rendered with columns=[] and tableData with data: [] and empty meta, ignoring result.data, loading and errors. Users with the flag see an empty table for every table widget.

findings.title: Attribute keys query no longer carries environment and its queryKey is not scoped to the endpoint
findings.body: The old query included environment: selection.environments; the new makeTraceItemAttributeKeysQueryOptions drops environment (commented as intentional) while the React Query key uses a fixed prefix plus query options, so cached results across page filters may be shared incorrectly. Also the hook's `error` is now returned but callers may ignore it, silently showing stale attributes.

findings.title: Error wrapping loses the original error object
findings.body: throw new Error(`...: ${e}`) stringifies the caught error and discards the stack and type, making debugging of attribute-key failures harder.

findings.title: Attribute value hook no longer respects enabled flag or attributeKey
findings.body: The hook signature dropped attributeKey and enabled, but callers like transactionNameSearchBar still pass attributeKey historically; the returned function is now a getter taking (tag, query). Callers relying on the old enabled flag to suppress requests will now fire requests unconditionally.

findings.title: Visualize model collapses multi-yAxis visualizations, breaking existing URLs
findings.body: The change moves from yAxes arrays to a single yAxis per Visualize, but fromJSON still accepts yAxes arrays and returns multiple objects; saved and shared links with multiple y-axes in one visualize entry now split into separate charts with different labels and stack behavior, and BaseVisualize.toJSON writes back yAxes: [single], changing the persisted URL format for all users.

findings.title: Chart info now only ever renders a single yAxis, dropping the default visualization dedupe
findings.body: getChartInfo takes a single yAxis and wraps it in an array; the previous dedupeArray guarding duplicate yAxes is removed, so duplicated series names can now appear in the same chart legend if the same yAxis is used twice.

findings.title: Grouping variant 'Type' rows removed from UI with no replacement
findings.body: All 'Type' key-value rows and their explanatory tooltips were deleted for every variant type, removing the only user-visible explanation of what kind of grouping variant is shown.

findings.title: Analytics event name changed from underscore to hyphen
findings.body: trackAnalytics('replay.view_html') was changed to 'replay.view-html', but the event key is part of the analytics contract; historical dashboards and the replayAnalyticsEvents map depend on the existing name, so this silently splits metrics.

findings.title: Transparent mask gradient now depends on theme background instead of white
findings.body: The transparent variant changed from rgba(255,255,255,...) to theme.background, which changes appearance in dark theme and is unrelated to the PR scope.

findings.title: PR comment test compares against stale expected strings
findings.body: The expected comments were rewritten to a new format and new environment suffix, but the GitLab test still uses self.another_organization while the GitHub comment-workflow test drops the culprit assertion; these tests can pass for the wrong reasons because titles are looked up by ordering from Group.objects without deterministic ordering in the updates test.

findings.title: get_environment_info logs issue with an exception object in extra and swallows errors broadly
findings.body: The bare except Exception logs the exception object as an extra value (not serializable in some logging backends) and silently returns empty environment text. Additionally get_merged_pr_single_issue_template calls PRCommentWorkflow._truncate_title from a staticmethod on CommitContextIntegration, which is a name that does not exist in that class scope and will raise NameError at runtime.
